verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Mixpanel does offer group/account-level analytics for B2B SaaS use cases, but notes it's gated behind a higher-priced plan, making it a real but non-trivial capability. No first-party docs in this evidence pack directly describe 'Group Analytics' setup, retention, or funnels at the account level. missing for 10: first-party documentation of Group Analytics/account-level funnels & retention, pricing-tier details, and independent validation of feature depth.
